decision.summary: Two regions stand out: (1) 480–544, where N and E begin coherent opposite-signed trends without return; (2) 490–664, where E rises then plateaus while N declines, forming a temporary platform (~550–600) that may indicate a pause in motion or onset of new regime. No unambiguous opposing returns are visible; U remains noisy but not clearly coupled.

regions.observation: N-component shows a sustained downward trend beginning around index 480, with a possible inflection near 510; E-component remains near zero until ~500 then begins a gentle upward ramp; U-component exhibits intermittent spikes but no coherent shift. The cross-axis shape suggests a coupled N-down/E-up motion emerging mid-window, without clear opposing return.

E-component displays a clear monotonic rise from ~index 490 to 550, then plateaus; N-component declines steadily through the same interval, forming an apparent platform between 550–600 where both axes stabilize before resuming drift. U-component shows elevated noise but no matching step—suggesting possible superposed transient or local effect.
